**Subject: Executive Briefing proposal for Tamarack Instruments**

Dear Dana Whitfield,

**Situation**

Tamarack Instruments designs and manufactures laboratory measurement instruments. It operates in the Netherlands, Germany and the United States with about 1,100 staff. The Client has deployed a customer service chatbot on its support portal, is piloting AI visual inspection on the German production line and plans AI sales forecasting next year. You have stated the objective of having governance in place before visual inspection goes into production in Q2 2027.

The Client's regulatory drivers are the EU AI Act and GDPR, and it targets ISO/IEC 42001 with work to start next year. It has also set two constraints: customer data must stay in the EU, and the German works council must be consulted before anything touches production staff.

**What the Briefing covers for Tamarack Instruments**

The Executive Briefing will cover four areas:

1. **Regulatory expectations.** The session maps expectations under the EU AI Act and GDPR to each use case. This includes transparency expectations for the chatbot and the risk classification question for visual inspection. All regulatory points are framed as expectations to verify with counsel, not legal advice. United States requirements are presented only as a general landscape item.
2. **Readiness.** A discussion anchored to the three use cases identifies what should exist before visual inspection enters production. It also shows where works council consultation and EU data residency enter the design.
3. **Operating model.** This segment uses the GRC Workbook (https://github.com/rolldabones/grc-workbook) and Slow AI Kitchen (https://github.com/rolldabones/slow-ai-kitchen). Board-level oversight draws on AI Governance for Boards (https://github.com/rolldabones/ai-governance-for-boards). The session applies three principles: Slow AI, Informed Intent and Final Liability rests with the Human.
4. **ISO/IEC 42001.** The session outlines how this groundwork relates to ISO/IEC 42001 preparation. It does not promise certification or audit outcomes.

**Logistics and price**

The Briefing is a two-hour live virtual session. It is designed for the General Counsel, CISO, Head of Quality, Head of Data, German plant manager and two internal auditors. The price is US$3,000.

**What you receive afterward**

You will receive a follow-up summary memo. It records the decisions surfaced and our readiness observations. It also sets out three prioritized recommendations, each mapped to a next program option with a proposed timeline.

**Next step**

The decision timeline is not yet known. We propose a short intake call to confirm three things:

- a session date
- which incumbent frameworks the Client uses
- whether any risk events should inform the discussion

Kind regards,
AI Governance Academy
